value.rationale: The result resolves an entire canonical family for a fault-tolerant locating invariant introduced to model one-device failure. It provides an if-and-only-if classification of every feasible set, a closed cardinality enumerator, exact small-order transitions, exact minimum counts, and a simple transversal description in the stable range n>=6.
